title: RoleCatalogEntry
description: Schema for a single hot-loadable role file under ./role-catalog/<role_id>.role.json. Declares one authoritative role with its industry, responsibility tags, optional parent for inheritance, and alias/display-name variants used by STEP 0 canonicalization.

role_id.description: Stable canonical role identifier; MUST match the file basename (excluding .role.json).

display_name.description: Optional single human-readable name. For multiple variants use display_names.

industry.description: Industry this role belongs to (e.g. ecommerce, legal, engineering, hr).

responsibility_tags.description: Responsibility vocabulary shared with metric.responsibility_tags, used by STEP 1.2 curation.

parent_role.description: role_id of a parent entry to inherit industry + responsibility_tags from, or null. Cycles / missing parents / depth > 8 are fail-soft (loaded without inheritance + open_question).

aliases.description: Alternate strings (Chinese + English variants) STEP 0 matches against during canonicalization, case-insensitively.

recognized_levels.description: Additional employee.role.level values this role recognizes beyond the built-in employee/supervisor/manager.
